SELECT res.* FROM (
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE 1 = 0 ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC)
(SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC)
(SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE 1 = 0 ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC)
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE 1 = 0) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId}) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE 1 = 0)
) res ORDER BY res.log_date DESC, res.id DESC

SELECT res.* FROM (
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE 1 = 0 ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE 1 = 0 ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE 1 = 0) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId}) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE 1 = 0)
) res ORDER BY res.log_date DESC, res.id DESC LIMIT 1
